metadata.title: The fate of close encounters between binary stars and binary supermassive black holes

notes: No eligible stars. The paper presents N-body simulations of generic stellar binaries (T:p4-b5) and discusses simulated HVS/TDE outcomes without naming or otherwise identifying individual stars. The only possible observed hypervelocity binary is referenced generically as “one such system” with no identifier (T:p13-b6), so it cannot be included.
